posts.title: Build like a Google engineer: modern Bazel with modules, Go and Typst
posts.description: A hands-on guide to modern Bazel with the module system: pinned toolchains, third-party Go libraries, images rendered with Typst, a custom rule backed by a Go tool, and a Go server with everything embedded, all built with one command.

posts.title: Building a static website with Bazel
posts.description: Build a complete static website with a single Bazel command using Pageforge: templates, Markdown posts, listings, tags, static files, a local dev server, and a zip ready for Cloudflare Pages.

posts.title: Writing your first compiler
posts.description: Build your first compiler with minimal, high-level, modern code. With only a few files of Go and C code, we can set up a workflow that dynamically fetches everything needed, including the LLVM library itself, and builds a portable compiler. This is a modern stack, it's reproducible, and you do not need to read dozens of pages to get started.
